author: Brenton Kemp
title: Javier Baez (ankle) begins running and hitting program
desc: Tigers utility player Javier Baez (ankle) has initiated a running and hitting program.
impact: Baez has been sidelined since suffering an ugly-looking ankle injury while stepping awkwardly on first base in an April 28 game against the Braves. The veteran remains without a timetable to return, but it appears his slow-moving rehab has taken a notable step forward.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Gleyber Torres (oblique) begins running progression
desc: Tigers second baseman Gleyber Torres (oblique) is completing a running progression along with rehab exercises.
impact: While Torres beginning to run is a positive sign, it's worth noting that he is not yet ready to resume hitting. The 29-year-old has had two injured list stints this season due to his oblique, but has been excellent when healthy, hitting .280 with four homers, a 15.3% BB% and a .790 OPS through 43 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) hopeful to begin rehab assignment soon
desc: Vinnie Pasquantino is hopeful to begin a rehab assignment before the All-Star break.
impact: Pasquantino will continue his rehab in Arizona to begin July. He landed on the injured list a couple of weeks ago and underwent surgery to remove a fractured hamate bone in his right hand.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Mickey Moniak goes yard in loss to Marlins
desc: Mickey Moniak went 1-for-4 in loss to the Marlins with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Moniak has heated back up at the plate since returning from injury, driving in runs in four of his last five contests. The outfielder offers fantasy managers one of the few impactful bats in the Rockies lineup to this point, posting an .875 OPS with 13 home runs, 32 RBI, 23 runs scored, one stolen base through 51 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tanner Gordon shelled early in return against Marlins
desc: Tanner Gordon allowed five earned runs on nine hits while striking out four over five innings in Tuesday's loss to the Marlins.
impact: Gordon continues a disappointing stretch on the mound, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last four trips to the mound. Fantasy managers can continue to avoid the pitcher in all formats, posting an 0-2 record and 8.7 K/9 ratio with a 6.69 ERA and 1.59 WHIP across 10 appearances.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Matt Chapman (abdominal) to undergo MRI Wednesday
desc: Giants third baseman Matt Chapman (abdominal) will undergo an MRI on Wednesday to determine the severity of his strain and whether an IL stint will be necessary.
impact: Chapman departed Tuesday's game against the D-backs with an abdominal issue, and it appears he could miss some time. He is already heading toward the paternity list with a baby due on July 5, but Wednesday's MRI will determine if additional time off will be required.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jeffrey Springs torched early in loss to Dodgers
desc: Jeffrey Springs allowed six earned runs on eight hits and four walks while striking out two over 5 1/3 innings in Tuesday's loss to the Dodgers.
impact: Springs continues a dismal stretch on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last six trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of the more underwhelming options in the Athletics rotation for manager Mark Kotsay, posting a 5.79 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 3-8 record and 7.7 K/9 ratio across 18 starts.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jameson Taillon (hamstring) to begin rehab assignment Sunday
desc: Cubs right-hander Jameson Taillon (hamstring) will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Iowa on Sunday.
impact: Taillon threw live batting practice on Tuesday and will begin a rehab assignment on Sunday as the next step in his recovery from a left hamstring strain that put him on the injured list on June 9. The veteran posted a 5.19 ERA across 13 starts before hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Ben Hansen traded to Athletics
desc: The Athletics have acquired right-hander  Ben Hansen from the Red Sox in exchange for infielder Brett Harris.
impact: The A's designated Harris for assignment before finding a trade partner with the Red Sox and acquiring Hansen. The 24-year-old has posted a 4.75 ERA in 13 outings (two starts) at High-A this season with the Red Sox, who drafted him in the 20th round of the 2024 MLB Draft.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colby Thomas homers in loss to Dodgers
desc: Colby Thomas went 2-for-3 in Tuesday's 9-3 loss to the Dodgers with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Thomas has heated up at the plate, driving in runs in three of his last four contests. The outfielder remains one of the more underwhelming options when in the Athletics lineup, batting .238 with four home runs, 10 RBI, 10 runs scored, and one stolen base through 39 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Soriano provides mixed results on mound against Mariners
desc: Jose Soriano allowed three earned runs on six hits and one walk while striking out nine over five innings in Tuesday's loss to the Mariners.
impact: Soriano has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last five contests. The right-hander remains one of the more stable starting options as part of an underwhelming Angels rotation, carrying a 3.42 ERA and 1.32 WHIP with an 8-5 record and 10.0 K/9 ratio across 18 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer to make rehab start Friday
desc: Max Scherzer told reporters he will make a rehab start on Friday.
impact: Scherzer will then rejoin the team in Seattle on Saturday and throw a side session on Sunday. There should be an update on him by the end of the weekend.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jovani Moran (elbow) activated from injured list
desc: The Red Sox have activated left-hander Jovani Moran (elbow) from the injured list.
impact: Moran was scheduled to appear for Double-A Portland on Wednesday, but will instead be activated with fellow lefty Connelly Early (elbow) being placed on the injured list. Moran pitched two scoreless innings on 14 pitches in his latest rehab outing and owns a 3.00 ERA across 21 appearances with the Red Sox this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Connelly Early (elbow) placed on 15-day IL
desc: Red Sox left-hander Connelly Early (elbow) has been placed on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Early left Tuesday's game against the Nationals after four innings and 61 pitches due to an elbow issue, and he will indeed hit the injured list with left elbow inflammation. The young southpaw has posted a 3.44 ERA across 17 starts this season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Yordan Alvarez blasts grand slam in win over Twins
desc: Yordan Alvarez went 3-for-4 in a win over the Twins with a grand slam.
impact: Alvarez has offered mixed results at the plate of late, collecting hits in five of his last 10 contests. The veteran continues to reward fantasy managers with an elite lineup option as one of the few stable bats in the Astros lineup, carrying a 1.046 OPS with 26 home runs, 60 RBI, 59 runs scored, and one stolen base across 86 games.
